# Banora

> A modular Go/Baduk/Weiqi SDK with headless JSON automation and an optional terminal CLI. Development packages are not published yet.

## Agent entrypoints

- [CLI guide](https://github.com/0disoft/banora/blob/main/packages/cli/README.md): Build/install locally, command discovery, stdin/files, exit codes and output ownership.
- [Automation contract](https://github.com/0disoft/banora/blob/main/docs/sdk/automation.md): Versioned request/response, logical coordinates, operations, isolated batches and limits.
- [Public API](https://github.com/0disoft/banora/blob/main/docs/sdk/public-api.md): Common SDK modules and optional framework adapters.
- [Host-controlled boards](https://github.com/0disoft/banora/blob/main/docs/sdk/controlled-board.md): External authority, snapshots and intentions.
- [Record playback](https://github.com/0disoft/banora/blob/main/docs/sdk/playback.md): Public replay state/commands, interval bounds and lifecycle; browser controls are explicit DOM mounts.
- [Validation](https://github.com/0disoft/banora/blob/main/VALIDATION.md): Actual configured local checks and remaining evidence.

Run `banora --help` and `banora schema` before constructing commands. Use JSON files or stdin; do not recreate rules, evaluate code, or infer the state from screenshots. CLI output is one JSON document. Each invocation is isolated; do not treat node IDs/Undo history as persistent or the CLI as automatic control over a running application.

- [UI localization](docs/sdk/localization.md): Explicit English/Korean/Chinese/Japanese Viewer and playback options, message overrides, board labels and Studio language selection.
